definitions.explanation: The time when the sun disappears below the horizon in the evening.

examples.japanese: {日没|にちぼつ}⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}ろう→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。

examples.english: The period from sunset to sunrise is called 'night.'

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日没|にちぼつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{早|はや}い→速い／早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{暗|くら}く→暗い：00647_kurai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{早|はや}い→速い／早い：00514_hayai⟧。
examples.english: In winter, sunset is early, so it gets dark outside quickly too.

examples.japanese: {日没|にちぼつ}⟦{後|ご}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{気温|きおん}→気温：00235_kion⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ぐっと→ぐっと：05179_gutto⟧⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{上着|うわぎ}→上着：01066_uwagi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦いった→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦ほう→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: The temperature drops sharply after sunset, so you should bring a jacket.

notes:
{日没|にちぼつ} is a formal/technical term for sunset.

FORMS:
⟦{日|にち}→日：02249_hi⟧ (sun, day) + ⟦{没|ぼつ}→没：noentry⟧ (sinking, setting) = {日没|にちぼつ}

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日没|にちぼつ}⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧/⟦{後|ご}→後：09580_ato⟧ - before/after sunset
- {日没|にちぼつ}⟦{時刻|じこく}→時刻：03270_jikoku⟧ - sunset time
- {日没|にちぼつ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{同時|どうじ}→同時：01592_douji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ - at sunset

{日没|にちぼつ} VS ⟦{日|ひ}の{入|い}り→日の入り：21211_hinoiri⟧ VS ⟦{夕暮|ゆうぐ}れ→夕暮れ：07682_yuugure⟧:
- {日没|にちぼつ} - formal, technical term for the moment the sun sets
- ⟦{日|ひ}の{入|い}り→日の入り：21211_hinoiri⟧ - standard word for sunset
- ⟦{夕暮|ゆうぐ}れ→夕暮れ：07682_yuugure⟧ - dusk, twilight (the period around sunset)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{日|ひ}の{出|で}→日の出：17596_hinode⟧ / ⟦{日出|にっしゅつ}→日出：noentry⟧ - sunrise
